licenses.gearData: Item stat definitions derived from Habitica source/content data (GPL v3). See habitica-gear.NOTICE.md and docs/habitica-assets.md.

provenance.modifications: Flattened to per-key numeric stats; the English names (text) kept at each key, read from the live content endpoint at textRetrievedAt (the numbers' revision is sourceRevision); notes and i18n strings omitted; no numeric values changed.

weapon_mystery_201502.text: Shimmery Winged Staff of Love and Also Truth

comment: Bundled Habitica gear/appearance catalog snapshot for Glimway. Numeric item data derived from Habitica content; art is NOT bundled here. Generated from GET https://habitica.com/api/v3/content (public, x-client only).

rules.spriteExistence: A sprite name is renderable iff it appears in upstream spritesmith-main.css (png) or constants/gifSprites.js (gif).
rules.noneValues: hair slot style 0, hair_flower_0, chair none, and *_base_0 / *_<klass>_0 tier pieces are intentional no-visual entries (spritelessGear / style 0) and render no layer.
rules.armorNaming: armor sprite names are size-prefixed: slim_<key> / broad_<key>. All other gear uses the bare key.
rules.petMountNaming: pet = 'Pet-'+key; mount = 'Mount_Body_'+key AND 'Mount_Head_'+key; gifSprites entries use .gif, everything else .png.
